newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Huangshan prices B share offer at US$0.258.
newsitem.headline: Huangshan prices B share offer at US$0.258.

text.p: Anhui-based Huangshan Tourism Development Co Ltd's offer of 80 million B shares has been priced at US$0.258 per share, an official of Shanghai Guotai Securities, the offer's main domestic underwriter, said.

The offer will carry a price-earnings ratio of 6.35 times based on forecast per-share net of 0.337 yuan on a fully diluted basis and under international accounting standards, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin on Tuesday.
A signing ceremony for the underwriting will be held in Shanghai on Tuesday night, he said, adding that Peregrine Capital Ltd has been appointed international coordinator.

The offer will be launched on Thursday, when Huangshan's B share offer prospectus will be released to the public, the official said. Huangshan expects to list the B shares in Shanghai next month, he said.
The same official last week said Huangshan would use proceeds from the offer to finance construction of a third cableway at the Huangshan mountain resort and renovate the facilities of a hotel there.
Under international accounting standards, Huangshan has forecast net earnings of 65 million yuan for 1996, compared with 45 million last year and 30 million in 1994, the official said.
